the spectrum of a thin manifold converges to that of a graph, but that the limit depends on the relative rate of shrinking of the manifold at vertices and along edges.

the spectrum of a graph-like manifold converges to the spectra of the limiting graphs, and that the type of convergence depends on the rate of shrinking.
